104.name: Northern Snow Ridge
104.desc: The high snow line spreads along the ridges, and cold winds have carved even the flat ground into slopes.

107.name: Broken Ridge Peaks
107.desc: The hardest backbone of the mountains, where peaks press against one another and form layer upon layer of broken ridges.

108.name: Cold Jade Summit
108.desc: High peaks under year-round snow, with sweeping views but the hardest passage of all.

110.name: Forest Valley Pass
110.desc: Mountain forest and gorge run side by side, forming a winding, hidden path through the mountains.

111.name: Volcano Forecourt
111.desc: The transitional belt at the volcano's outer edge, where rock heat and cold wind clash at close quarters.

114.name: Heart of Ten Thousand Mountains
114.desc: The core where mountains overlap; the roads are narrow, the peaks dense, and the terrain extremely perilous.

101.name: Pass Flatland
101.desc: A rare stretch of flat land among the mountains where the river valley opens a little; the frontier's people gather here.

102.name: Western Foothills Loess Belt
102.desc: Dry loess and gravel slopes in the western foothills; wind-blown sand pours in through the passes, yet this is no open desert.

103.name: Southern Ridge Jungle
103.desc: Hot, humid jungle at the foot of the southern mountains, where rain and mist coil along the slopes and never disperse.

105.name: Eastern Frontier Narrow Sea
105.desc: A narrow sea stretching along the eastern cliffs; the coast is thin and often squeezed by the peaks into broken coves.

106.name: Rushing Gorge River
106.desc: A swift river cutting through the mountains, its roar echoing between the gorge walls; many roads follow its valley.

112.name: Valley Farmland
112.desc: Fields nourished by the river in the mountain valleys; small in area, yet a rare granary for the frontier.

113.name: Southern Foothills Poison Marsh
113.desc: A wet marsh deep in the southern foothill woods, where cold mountain water and humus mix into a treacherous bog.

115.name: Purple Bamboo Hollow
115.desc: A secluded purple bamboo realm in a mountain hollow, where bamboo grows against the rock walls and the wind sounds especially cold and clear.

116.name: Northeastern Tundra
116.desc: A frozen plateau on the northeastern side of the range, where cold winds settle for long spells after crossing the snow line.

117.name: Western Ridge Shattered Star Slope
117.desc: Gravel slopes on the outer edge of the Western Ridge, where legends of meteoric iron and weathered rock make every step a struggle.

118.name: Eastern Sea Lost Islet
118.desc: A forgotten islet beyond the Eastern Frontier Narrow Sea, like a fragment that broke off where mountain meets sea.

201.name: Western Ridge Gold Mansion
201.desc: A Metal-element cave dwelling deep among the broken peaks of the Western Ridge, where sword hums often reverberate between the stone walls.

203.name: Gorge River Mystic Water Realm
203.desc: A Water-element secret realm at a bend of the gorge river, where rapids cut through stone walls and the spiritual qi in the deep pools runs cold.

302.name: Western Ridge Post Town
302.desc: A frontier post town at the western foothill pass, where mining crews, hunters, and traveling cultivators all resupply.

304.name: Gorge River City
304.desc: A river city on the lower gorge river, where mountain goods and spirit materials flow in along the rapids.

409.name: Southern Foothills Floating Islands
409.desc: A cluster of floating islands hanging above the Southern Foothills Poison Marsh, using cloud bridges and flying boats to avoid the miasma below.

411.name: Southern Mountains Maze Heaven
411.desc: A folded mountain gate in the southern mountains, where trails and arrays overlap so tightly that direction is nearly impossible to discern.
